rules.name: Exclusion of Non-Traditional (Leveraged & Inverse) ETFs
rules.regulatory_source: FINRA Regulatory Notice 09-31 & FINRA Regulatory Notice 12-03 (Complex Products)
rules.firm_policy_threshold: Firm Policy: 0% allocation. Leveraged and inverse ETFs are strictly excluded.
rules.description: FINRA Notice 09-31 specifies that leveraged and inverse ETFs reset daily and are designed for short-term trading, experiencing severe compounding volatility decay over longer periods. Leveraged and inverse products are excluded from buy-and-hold client portfolios.

rules.name: Time Horizon, Liquidity & Capital Preservation
rules.regulatory_source: Reg BI Care Obligation (SEA Rule 15l-1); Time Horizon & Liquidity factors under FINRA Rule 2111
rules.firm_policy_threshold: Firm Policy: Horizons < 3 yrs forbid Risk >= 4 & alternatives and require >= 50% fixed income/cash; high liquidity needs cap Risk <= 3 and require >= 30% fixed income/cash; preservation objective caps Risk <= 3.
rules.description: Short time horizons (< 3 years), high liquidity needs, and preservation objectives limit capacity to absorb drawdowns without forced liquidation.

rules.name: Customer Risk Tolerance Alignment
rules.regulatory_source: Reg BI Care Obligation (SEA Rule 15l-1); Risk Tolerance factor under FINRA Rule 2111
rules.firm_policy_threshold: Firm Policy: Product Risk Rp <= Ri + 1; Weighted Portfolio Risk <= Ri + 0.50.
rules.description: Recommendations must align with customer risk tolerance. An individual product may exceed tolerance by at most 1 level (with disclosure), and portfolio weighted risk cannot exceed Ri + 0.50.

rules.name: Senior Investor Risk Capping
rules.regulatory_source: Reg BI Care Obligation (SEA Rule 15l-1); Customer Age factor under FINRA Rule 2111
rules.firm_policy_threshold: Firm Policy: Age 70+ capped at Risk 3; Age 65-69 capped at Risk 4.
rules.description: Age is an explicit suitability factor under FINRA 2111 and Reg BI. Firm policy prohibits Risk 5 products for ages 65-69 and restricts investors age 70+ to Risk 1-3.

rules.name: Investor Experience & Complex Products
rules.regulatory_source: FINRA Regulatory Notice 12-03 (Heightened Supervision of Complex Products) & Reg BI Care Obligation
rules.firm_policy_threshold: Firm Policy: Beginners forbidden from Risk 5, alternatives/crypto, and futures-based products (is_futures_based=True).
rules.description: FINRA Notice 12-03 requires heightened supervision for complex products. Beginners cannot hold Risk 5 products, alternatives, or futures-based commodity funds subject to contango/roll decay; physical bullion funds are permitted.

rules.name: Portfolio Diversification & Single-Product Caps
rules.firm_policy_threshold: Firm Policy: Warning above 50% single-product allocation; hard block above 60%; >80% asset-class concentration warning.
rules.description: Firm policy issues a concentration warning above 50% (including at 60%) and blocks any single-product allocation above 60%. Asset-class allocations above 80% trigger a diversification warning.

rules.name: Investable Assets & High-Risk Exposure Cap
rules.regulatory_source: Reg BI Care Obligation; Financial Situation & Needs factor under FINRA Rule 2111
rules.firm_policy_threshold: Firm Policy: High-risk products (Risk 4-5) capped at 30% of portfolio when investable_assets < $25,000, and 60% otherwise.
rules.description: Limits high-volatility exposure (Risk 4-5) relative to the client's liquid investable assets so potential drawdowns do not impair core financial stability.
